## Fixed

- **No more freeze when the wallpaper changes.** Each new wallpaper made the launcher throw away every app icon and make them all again just to give themed icons the new colours, which froze the home screen for a moment. Themed icons take their colour when they are drawn, so the icons are now kept and only drawn again in the new colours. Icons from an icon pack, or ones you picked, have the colour in the picture and are remade in the background. When Android sends several colour changes in a row, they are handled once.
